entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This petition, through jail, is filed by the petitioner seeking furlough leave on the ground of financial assistance to his family.

2. It transpires that the petitioner is convicted for 25 years imprisonment on 17.07.2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(J)(N), 201 of the IPC and Sections 6, 4, 18 of the POCSO Act.
It further transpires that the petitioner was recently released in the month of January 2026 for 21 days parole leave, considering the same, no case is made out.

3. Registry to communicate this order to the concerned jail authority.
(P. M. RAVAL, J) NITIN MAKWANA Dineshbhai Bhikhabhai Rathod vs State Of Gujarat on 2 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155145959/
